_about: New Year's Eve 2026 listings (v2.U). An entry ships only when an official or organiser page confirms it for 2026. Re-check with scripts/nye-reverify.mjs on 15 and 28 Dec 2026 (README).

entries.name: First Night Monterey
entries.hours_text: The grand finale, with the countdown to midnight, is indoors from 11:15pm.
entries.price: Button $30–35 adults (16+), $15–20 ages 6–15; 5 and under free. Early-bird prices to 14 Dec
entries.note: An alcohol-free arts festival: one button gets you into 50+ performances in halls, churches and theatres downtown, most of them indoors.

entries.name: The Countdown Club at Portola Hotel & Spa
entries.venue: Portola Hotel & Spa, De Anza Ballroom
entries.hours_text: Room packages with two party tickets are sold separately by the hotel.
entries.note: A 1920s speakeasy-themed party: the ticket covers an open bar, a buffet dinner, a live band and a champagne toast at midnight.

entries.name: The Dirty Dozen Brass Band
entries.hours_text: The theatre's page gives no end time or price; both are on the ticket page.
entries.note: New Orleans brass on New Year's Eve at the Golden State Theatre downtown.

entries.name: The Beat Goes On New Year's Eve Bash
entries.hours_text: PacRep has not printed a start time; it runs until the ball drops.
entries.note: Pacific Repertory Theatre's Sonny & Cher tribute concert, played as a party.

entries.name: Le Rouge New Year's Eve
entries.venue: Courtyard by Marriott Sand City Monterey
entries.hours_text: The cheaper ticket gets in from 10pm. Parking on site is free.
entries.note: A red-and-black themed night with a DJ, aerial performers, food stations and tastings; the organiser says it is not a seated dinner. Sand City sits between Seaside and Monterey.

entries.name: New Year's Eve Party at The Catalyst
entries.hours_text: Tables for six or eight are discounted.
entries.note: Downtown's big club night: a Bruno Mars tribute show, the Isaah Picket Band and a DJ, with a champagne toast at midnight.

entries.name: Moe's Alley NYE Bash with Wooster
entries.note: Wooster headlines the music club's own New Year's Eve show.

entries.name: New Year's Eve Party at Chaminade with SambaDá
entries.hours_text: Doors 8:30pm. The resort has not printed the price after 4 December.
entries.price: $108.40 early bird to 4 Dec, tax and gratuity included; room package from $585
entries.note: Afro-Brazilian dance band SambaDá plays the resort's party, with a champagne toast.

entries.name: China Cats New Year's Eve at the Vets Hall
entries.note: A Grateful Dead tribute band's annual New Year's ball, with a liquid light show.

entries.name: New Year's Eve Party at Seascape Golf Club
entries.hours_text: This is the golf club's clubhouse, not Seascape Beach Resort.
entries.note: Live music, light bites and a champagne toast at midnight in the clubhouse.

entries.name: New Year's Eve dinner at Shadowbrook
entries.hours_text: Reservations open Tuesday 1 December at 10am, online or on 831-475-1511. No menu or price posted yet.
entries.note: Capitola's creekside restaurant takes New Year's Eve dinner bookings from 1 December.

entries.name: New Year's Day at Shadowbrook
entries.hours_text: Reservations open Wednesday 2 December at 10am. No hours or menu posted yet.
entries.note: Open on New Year's Day, with bookings opening the day after New Year's Eve's.
